visualCharacteristics: Side-by-side promo: an image on one side and a text column (heading, description, CTA) on the other. Stacks vertically on mobile, side-by-side at 900px.
contentPattern: A single row with two cells: an image-only cell (tagged for ordering) and a text cell (heading, description, CTA link).
usage: Feature/promo rows inside the self-serve tab panels (e.g. 'File or track your claim online').
